summary: Epsilon Energy Ltd. filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Roth Capital Partners, LLC for at-the-market (ATM) offerings. The company may sell up to $15 million of its common shares at prevailing market prices through the agent. Roth receives a 3% commission on gross proceeds. The shares are issued under an existing effective shelf registration statement (Form S-3). This is a routine equity distribution arrangement, not a special situation. No stake, premium, or strategic event is involved. The filing is an ordinary current report on a material definitive agreement for capital raising.
